text.p: (Corrects headline to read "shrinks" instead of "rises". Also corrects text to include operating share figures.)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE - Q1 1997 direct premiums written $16.45 million versus $14.16 million. Q1 1997 assumed premiums written $261,000 versus $874,000. Q1 1997 ceded premiums written was a loss of $4.35 million versus a loss of $1.91 million.
Q1 1997 net premiums written were $12.37 million versus $13.12 million.
Q1 1997 net premiums earned were $12.0 million versus $8.83 million.
Q1 1997 total expenses $11.64 million versus $8.28 million.
